About This Game

Simulate the learning process of Chinese high school students. During weekly study sessions, continuously enhance your mastery of knowledge points through QTE gameplay. Upon successfully completing a QTE, you will earn points needed to draw skills. Randomly select a skill from the skill pool. If you draw the rarest red skill, it will significantly boost your learning efficiency. After the last class of each day, a daily summary will be conducted. If you receive an S+ rating for all subjects on that day, you will earn an additional skill point. Every weekend, there will be 9 exams. After the exams, you can compare your scores with your classmates based on the scores of each subject. If half of your scores are higher than those of your classmates, you can win the right to use their desk. The desks are divided into 4 levels of learning efficiency. When you feel confident in your mastery of knowledge points, or by the end of the 30th week, you will face the final exam: the college entrance examination. After the exam, your score will determine the university and major you can attend. The core gameplay of this game is QTE, which includes 81 skills. Skills are divided into permanent and temporary skills, and can be categorized into 5 levels based on rarity. The only main quest is "Study - Exam," which includes a total of 14 tables and chairs with different learning efficiency bonuses, spanning 5 levels of knowledge point mastery: Mastered - Reviewed Once - Reviewed Twice - Reviewed Three Times - Reviewed Fully. The requirement for mastery of knowledge points in the exam will randomly increase after each weekend exam. The final college entrance examination requires mastery of all assessed knowledge points.
